text:
viv: quick flag from onboarding call — customer hit silent fallback because our Terraform + CLI examples still use `labels` for tenant isolation instead of the new `isolation_decorators`. they expected hard-reservation semantics and weren't isolated.
anika: ack. do we have a PR?
viv: opened a draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6010. i pushed a patch but CI is unhappy about a code fence and an anchor.
rahul: paste the exact snippet that confused the customer and the expected runtime schema?
viv: snippet in docs (old):
```hcl
resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "ingest" {
  reserved = true
  labels = ["tenant:ingest", "env:prod"]
}
```
rahul: runtime now expects `isolation_decorators` (HCL objects) and explicit `eviction_policy`. using `labels` falls back to best-effort scheduling which may be preempted under pressure. that explains the customer surprise.
anika: plan: 1) update HCL example to runtime schema, 2) add a short migration table mapping old->new keys, 3) include a CLI snippet showing `redwoodctl capacity create --eviction-policy NO_EVICT --decorator tenant=ingest` so infra folks can quickly migrate, 4) add a tiny parser-test that asserts docs/examples/ use the new keys.
viv: updated PR branch with corrected HCL and added CLI example, but lint-bot flagged the HCL block (HCL linter expects object syntax) and linkcheck found a dead anchor at /docs/dedicated#reserved-pools-anchor. docs-bot created preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/terraform-migrate-6010
rahul: can you paste the corrected snippet?
viv: corrected HCL I pushed:
```hcl
resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "ingest" {
  reserved = true
  eviction_policy = "NO_EVICT"
  isolation_decorators = [
    { tenant = "ingest" },
    { env = "prod" }
  ]
}
```
anika: perfect. for the CLI example i used: `redwoodctl capacity create --reserved --eviction-policy NO_EVICT --decorator tenant=ingest --decorator env=prod` — adding that to the migration note should help ops teams.
rahul: also propose adding a one-line callout: "Behavior change: `labels` in docs map to best-effort scheduling; to guarantee isolation use `isolation_decorators` + `NO_EVICT`." small wording change avoids blaming customers.
docs-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/terraform-migrate-6010 (checks running)
lint-bot: docs-lint failed — add `hcl` language tag to code fences, and anchor /docs/dedicated#reserved-pools-anchor missing (404).
anika: i'll add the language tag and fix the anchor target in the reserved-pools page. rahul — can you add the parser-test in your runtime repo and link it in the PR description so CI can catch regressions?
rahul: will add `runtime/tests/docs_examples_parse_test.py` that loads examples/terraform and fails if `labels` keys are present in capacity pool examples. will link PR when ready.
viv: pushed the hcl language tag and the migration table; pinging @anika @rahul for final review — hoping to merge today once the runtime test links are in. thanks! :rocket:
